description: T6-4 (docs/test-campaigns/phase-12.md): the watch rebuild is submitted to the loop's multi-worker default executor and not awaited (broadcast from a done-callback), so the loop pulls the next change while a rebuild is still running and two _build_static_graph calls race the unlocked caches. Both serialization mechanisms are gone at once, which is what it takes: see the two 'survives' siblings.

target.replace:
_rebuild = loop.run_in_executor(
                None, _build_static_graph, root, meta_cache, predicted_ctx
            )
            _rebuild.add_done_callback(
                lambda f: f.cancelled()
                or f.exception() is not None
                or f.result() is None
                or asyncio.ensure_future(
                    broadcast(protocol.make_static_graph(f.result()), connections)
                )
            )
            graph = None
